<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Kineticist Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4333) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
<trait label="Dedication" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=41" />
<trait label="Multiclass" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=115" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 57

**Archetype** [Kineticist](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=206)

**Prerequisites**
Constitution 2

</column>

---

You become trained in kineticist class DC and impulse attack rolls. Choose one element to be your kinetic element (air, earth, fire, metal, water, or wood). You gain a kinetic aura and the [Channel Elements](/Actions.aspx?ID=2124) action, though you don't get to use an Elemental Blast or stance impulse when you take that action. You gain the [Elemental Blast](/Actions.aspx?ID=2125) action. Your Elemental Blast does not automatically gain additional damage dice every four levels, instead requiring you to take the [Improved Elemental Blast](/Feats.aspx?ID=4337) feat. You become trained in Nature; if you were already trained in Nature, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

<title level="2">Kineticist Dedication leads to...</title>
[Base Kinesis](/Feats.aspx?ID=4334), [Expert Kinetic Control](/Feats.aspx?ID=4339), [Improved Elemental Blast](/Feats.aspx?ID=4337), [Through the Gate](/Feats.aspx?ID=4335)
name: Kineticist Dedication
